notes: Ships are groups, not channels you sit in: a ship row carries LSN ALL and TX ALL, so you can hear or reach every net aboard without tuning any of them. Channel rows lead with the net's name now, with the frequency small beneath it, and you can drag nets into whatever order suits you — local to your install, never sent to the relay, and a net can move within its nest but never out of one. You also arrive tuned to NOTHING: no more being dropped onto live nets you didn't pick. Plus soundboard fixes (level-matched clips, no more stutter, and the log names who played what), no more keybinds you didn't set, staggered relay connections with back-off, microphone and output device pickers, and a header, slider row and channel name that all stay on screen at any window size.
